source.caption: Identification and functional analysis of candidate genes associated with mitochondrial dynamics in IPF. (A) Volcano plot of differentially expressed genes between IPF and control groups. (B) Heatmap of differentially expressed genes. (C) Consensus clustering heatmap. (D) Volcano plot of differentially expressed genes between Cluster1 and Cluster2. (E) Venn diagram of candidate genes. (F) GO and KEGG enrichment analyses of candidate genes (the top three pathways). (G) PPI network of candidate genes. (H) Genes in the top-scoring module.
